result.summary: Found 4 issues: horizontal content cutoff at the screen edge, category filter chip truncated, restaurant card cropped at edge, and inconsistent heart icon contrast between cards.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccolo' card and its delivery info are cut off at the right edge of the screen, indicating horizontal overflow not properly contained within viewport.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll container clips content properly or add visual indication (fade/gradient) that more content is scrollable.

issues.description: The category filter row (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) shows a partially cut off chip at the right edge, suggesting more categories exist but isn't clearly indicated.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or partial visibility cue to signal scrollable content.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the ramen bar image is white/outlined while on the pizza image below it appears with a dark filled background, creating inconsistent styling between similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon's background and style across all food cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The pizza item at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cropped, cutting off its name and details before the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Adjust spacing or scroll padding so cards are not visually cut off awkwardly at the viewport boundary.
